title: Robust Camera Pose Refinement for Multi-Resolution Hash Encoding
heroTitle: Robust Camera Pose Refinement for Multi-Resolution Hash Encoding
overview: I led the research on jointly refining camera poses while training an Instant-NGP-style Radiance Field. Hash encoding accelerated neural rendering, but its coordinate gradients became unstable when the camera poses also had to move.

We traced the failure to interpolation across hash-grid cells and redesigned the backward path while preserving the fast forward behavior. The result jointly calibrated SE(3) poses and learned the scene at accelerated-NeRF speed.
contributions: Identified oscillating coordinate gradients as the failure mode of hash-grid pose refinement.
Designed smooth backward interpolation with a straight-through trilinear forward path.
Added level-wise curriculum training for stable coarse-to-fine registration.
description: ICML 2023 case study on stabilizing camera-pose gradients while retaining the rapid convergence of hash-grid Neural Radiance Fields.
